来年之势The year ahead

同样生活在2027年，为什么每个人的节奏都不一样？ One year, one world. So why does 2027 feel so different for each of us?

2027年，2＋0＋2＋7＝11，再化简为1＋1＝2。按照 Joyce 采用的数字能量计算方式，2027年属于世界流年2。 Add it up: 2 + 0 + 2 + 7 = 11, and 1 + 1 = 2. In the numerology Joyce works with, 2027 is a World Year 2.

世界流年2的关键词包括合作、关系、协调、耐心与累积。它提供一个观察大环境的角度，但不代表每个人都会遇到相同的事情。 A World Year 2 speaks of partnership, relationships, patience and steady building. It describes the climate of the year, not what will happen to you.

世界流年告诉我们大环境，个人流年帮助我们看清自己的节奏。 The world year shows you the weather. Your personal year shows you how to walk through it.

真正值得进一步了解的是：你目前处于什么人生阶段？这一年的个人周期有什么主题？你的目标、资源与准备程度又是什么？ The better question is a personal one. Which chapter of life are you in right now? What is this year really asking of you? And where do your goals, resources and readiness stand?
